title: spec: retire the `page` member of the list-view `type` enum and its `pageName` mount — enforce-or-remove, the objectui render half was never built (maintainer 2026-09-09 「撤」)
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon #20, `session_01Tep4AYXZvyBA7jsvne5KZV`, GitHub `os-bill`) executing a maintainer ruling. `domain:spec` set by the mechanical rule 凡触 `packages/spec` 一律转 spec 座位; triage corrects if it disagrees.

## Ruling (who / verbatim / where)

Maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat, 2026-09-09T05:3xZ, on decision batch #107 item 1 (objectui#8429) after two questions — what a `type: 'page'` list view is, and when the requirement was decided and whether it is valuable. Presented options: **A** finish the objectui delegating mount · **撤** retire the enum member from spec under enforce-or-remove · **D** park with the current-state pin. Reply, verbatim: 「撤」.

`Governing text:` the 2026-08-29 ruling on #13216 (direction 1: a `page` member on the view type enum, render delegated to the page renderer — landed on the spec side as PR #13372 `d23dc08a`; the objectui mount half never landed, objectui#8429); ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove; the four-axis principle 「已发布零消费的能力不因沉没成本获得豁免」 (SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉); `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` `/props/list/children/type/note` and `/props/list/children/pageName/*`.

## What is measured (2026-09-09, `origin/main` `c0e4bc74`+)

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:1848` — `'page'` in the `ListViewSchema.type` enum; `:1946-1970` `pageName`; `:1632-1720` `checkListViewPageMount` + the three refusal messages (`VIEW_PAGE_MOUNT_NEEDS_PAGE_NAME`, `VIEW_PAGE_NAME_NEEDS_PAGE_TYPE`, `VIEW_PAGE_MOUNT_HAS_COLUMNS`), attached at `:2138`, `:3720`, `:4633` (three list-view doors).
- `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts#validateCrossReferences` — the build-time page-name existence branch; `packages/lint/src/validate-view-page-refs.ts#validateViewPageRefs` — the CLI / publish-gate resolution (`runtimeTypes: ['flow','view']`).
- `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` — the `pageName` rows and the `type` note quoted above.
- Real usage: **zero** authored `type: 'page'` list views in this tree or any consuming app the seats can read (objectui#8429's census; the 25 in-tree `type: 'page'` hits are app **nav items**, a different key that stays). objectui's `ListView` maps `page` → `grid` with a warn (declared ≠ enforced).
- Direction 3 of #13216 (command-palette indexing of published pages, PR #14249) is **not** part of this retirement and stays. Direction 2's design card #13620 is untouched.

## Deliverable — follow `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement` end to end

1. Remove `'page'` from the list-view `type` enum on every door that carries it (`ListViewSchema`, `ObjectListViewSchema`, `ListViewOverlayWireSchema` and any mirror), remove `pageName`, `checkListViewPageMount` and its three messages, the `validateCrossReferences` branch and `validateViewPageRefs` (or narrow them to what remains), and every docblock / `VIEW_HISTORY` line that describes the mount — replace with the standard tombstone naming this card and the ruling.
2. Liveness ledger: retire the `pageName` rows and rewrite the `type` note; regenerate every generated baseline / form / skill reference the playbook lists (⛔ never by hand).
3. ADR-0087: a stored view with `type: 'page'` or a `pageName` key is refused by name at rehydration and by `os migrate meta` (zero producers ⇒ `not-required` / refuse-by-name per the playbook's route choice; the dev records the route and its reason in the changeset).
4. Docs: every `content/docs/**` mention of the page view type / `pageName` on views is removed or rewritten (the nav-item `type: 'page'` docs are a different key and stay).
5. Pins: a refusal pin per door (`type: 'page'` refused; `pageName` refused as unknown key), and the liveness/enum ratchets green.
6. Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` (and `@objectstack/lint` if touched) `minor` with the **BREAKING** banner under the launch-window convention, naming what an author loses and the tombstone.

Dispatch shape: `Clause-②: no` — an accept-set narrowing / retirement (#16349 direction), ordinary tier; the path arm hits (`packages/spec/src/**`) so the in-seat contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is on record before enqueue per SKILL.md 〈入队与落地〉.

## Downstream

objectui#8429 becomes the objectui half — retire `UNDRAWABLE_VIEW_KINDS.page`, the `normalizeListViewSchema` warn arm and the PR #8684 current-state pin once the spec release carrying this removal is installable (cross-repo unlock criterion = 消费方可安装, not merged). It carries `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#<this card>`.

Dedupe: #13216 (closed, the ruling that added the member), #13100 (closed, the finding), #13620 (direction 2 design card — different question); no open card asks for this removal.
